traditional: the Moon opposition Jupiter: a hard contact. The body, home, and daily needs works against growth, fortune, and patronage - obstruction, friction, and strained outcomes in these areas.
modern: Feelings meet optimism and expansion. A resilient inner buoyancy that recovers no matter what, plus real generosity. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Emotional and physical excess; overindulgence and overcommitment. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.meaning: Feeling and growth reach full awareness and face each other: culmination, objectivity, fulfillment or confrontation.

business: Friction in this area. Warmth and generosity that draw people in; watch the tendency to overextend.
shadow: Moodiness and over-need collides with excess and overreach; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: A confrontation builds; the other side comes fully into view.
arcSeparating: The standoff resolves into balance or a split.
base: One piece of good news can look enormous while one disappointment can make progress seem much smaller than it did yesterday.

readerCopy.body: One piece of good news can look enormous while one disappointment can make progress seem much smaller than it did yesterday. When the Moon opposes Jupiter, emotional reactions expand the meaning of whatever just happened, making optimism and disappointment harder to keep in proportion. You may notice one update changing the whole emotional story even though most of the underlying facts are still the same. A strong mood can be valid without containing the whole picture.
